newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dovechem says contract to boost turnover.
newsitem.headline: Dovechem says contract to boost turnover.

text.p: Dovechem Terminal Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has been awarded a five-year contract by Shell Eastern Petroleum Ltd.

Dovechem did not give a figure for the value of the contract -- for supplying steel drums, bitumen handling and stevedoring operations -- but said it would boost turnover for the financial year ending June 30, 1998 by 15 percent.
For the next financial year it would boost turnover by 30 percent, Dovechem said in a statement.
Singapore-based Dovechem provides bulk liquid storage, handling, packaging and break-bulk distribution services and produces steel drums.
For the half-year to December 31, 1996, it reported turnover of Singapore $27.08 million.
